lines.t: I walked a road so dry so cold
Chasing dreams that turned to gold
But the weight it bent my soul
Then I heard a name in the wind
A whisper that could cleanse my sin
Your love shines brighter than the stars
You healed my heart you broke my scars
The night was deep the shadows grew
I lost my way I lost my view
But your light came pouring through
You called me back from the edge
You lifted me from my own wreckage
Your love shines brighter than the stars
You healed my heart you broke my scars
